title: Relations and Efficient Realizations of New PPRF Notions
summary: Only partial relations and possible instantiations are known; fully characterize the new PPRF notions against existing definitions and realize them efficiently.

formal_statement.body: Fully characterize how the new PPRF notions relate to existing definitions and how they can be realized efficiently.

scope.domain: Security definitions and efficient constructions for multi-user puncturable pseudorandom functions.
parameters: fpr-1ro, fpr-ro, and fpr-rro: the new multi-user PPRF security notions being compared and realized
scope.unresolved_remainder: A full characterization of how the new notions relate to existing PPRF definitions and how they can be realized efficiently.

citations.label: Puncturable Key Wrapping and Its Applications

progress.summary: The paper establishes partial implications and comparisons among its new multi-user PPRF notions and discusses possible instantiations. It leaves their full relationship to existing definitions and their efficient realization for future work.
citation_labels: Matilda Backendal et al., Puncturable Key Wrapping and Its Applications
